title: Print a document with WebPrint
resolution_html:
1. Check that your YU-card or supported mobile printing account has sufficient funds
  2. Sign in to WebPrint with your Passport York account
  3. Select Submit a Job and choose the required printer
  4. Choose print options and the number of copies
  5. Upload the document and submit it for printing
  6. Release or collect the job according to instructions posted at the printer
